rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone who notices and understands things quickly.

example.english: They are very perceptive, noticing even the smallest changes.
example.traditional: 佢做嘢好細心，連最細微嘅變化都留意到，真係觀察力強。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 sai3 sam1 lin4 zeoi3 sai3 mei4 ge3 bin3 faa3 dou1 lau4 ji3 dou3 zan1 hai6 gun1 caat3 lik6 koeng4

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone reads other people’s feelings, motives, or character accurately.

example.english: Ming is perceptive when it comes to people and spotted right away that person was unreliable.
example.traditional: 阿明睇人好準，一早就睇出嗰個人唔可靠。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 tai2 jan4 hou2 zeon2 jat1 zou2 zau6 tai2 ceot1 go2 go3 jan4 m4 ho2 kaau3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing deep insight into the reasons or meaning beneath what is obvious.

example.english: She is very perceptive when analyzing problems and does not just look at the surface.
example.traditional: 佢分析問題好有洞察力，唔會只係睇表面。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fan1 sik1 man6 tai4 hou2 jau5 dung6 caat3 lik6 m4 wui5 zi2 hai6 tai2 biu2 min6
